scope: Static independent whole Core text oracle only. No compiler/test execution, CoreCLI, native, VM, Source admission, runtime qualification or OS execution authority is supplied.

frozenFixture.caseInput: Each entire expectedHir object is identical to its independently authored hirJcsNoLf; complete nested snapshot, context and prior identity/range witnesses are retained in this pinned source fixture.

derivationRules: Module header, function metadata and exact text grammar were read statically from baseline nullable-core-emitter.mjs. Only permitted new tag_test/get leaves and the private H6 bool-to-i1 mapping are hypothesized; baseline rejects HIR4.

Shared SSA lines145-160 establish yes/no creation, complete outer s3/s4 join arguments and register/block order; lines351-356 establish label indentation and printing. No shared emitter code is run or translated into a general recursive emitter.

Four complete expected strings use manually laid-out one-guard and two-guard block templates filled from frozen literalSourcePlan and complete HIR metadata. Expected output was never copied from actual compiler output.

Core schema JCS, entire HIR JCS identities and private bool type hash are rechecked by pure JSON/UTF8/SHA256 data operations. Existing full identity-preimage evidence is reused from the frozen fixture; this subtask does not recompute all prior preimages.

All original condition/if/then-return/final-reference/final-return/entry-function/argument/call ranges are checked directly against frozen HIR; exact Source token slices confirm the tag and original trivia.
